title: AAPL Volatility Analysis
content: Apple Inc (AAPL) exhibits elevated implied volatility in near-term options expiring within 30 days. The volatility surface shows a pronounced smile pattern with strike prices at 180 and 200 showing IV of 35% and 38% respectively. This suggests market participants are pricing in significant price movement risk. Historical volatility (30-day) stands at 28%, indicating the current IV represents a premium over realized volatility. Traders should consider this when evaluating option strategies.

title: AAPL Options Chain Deep Dive
content: The AAPL options chain for December expiration shows concentrated open interest at the 190 strike for calls and 185 strike for puts. This creates potential support/resistance levels. The put/call ratio is 0.85, suggesting moderate bullish sentiment. Near-the-money options display high gamma, making them sensitive to underlying price changes. Volatility skew favors downside protection with put IV averaging 2-3% higher than equidistant calls.
